name: Thattai
subtitle: flat, crisp rice discs studded with dal and curry leaf

ingredients.note: the studs; they should stay whole and crunchy

prepNotes: Thattai means flat. They are pressed thin by hand between plastic sheets, not rolled.
Prick each disc before frying or it puffs into a ball.

steps.text: Mix the flours, soaked chana dal, torn curry leaves, sesame, asafoetida, chilli powder, salt and butter.
Add water gradually to a stiff dough. It should not be sticky.
Take small balls and flatten each between two greased plastic sheets into thin discs.
Prick each disc several times with a fork.
steps.tip: This is not optional. Unpricked thattai balloons and cooks unevenly.

steps.text: Fry on medium until the bubbling subsides and they are pale gold and rigid, about 4 minutes.
Drain and cool completely before storing.

storage: Keeps 3 weeks in an airtight tin at room temperature. If they soften, 5 minutes in a low oven brings them back.
